summary: By the time we got to Hass it evolved into #walkmyworld and we had hundreds of teachers participating in this unofficial @ncte project from across the globe. We should start up the Digital Laurette project again.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: By the time we got to Hass it evolved into #walkmyworld and we had hundreds of teachers participating in this unofficial @ncte project from across the globe. We should start up the Digital Laurette project again.
